SELECT "orders_order"."id", "orders_order"."user_id", "orders_order"."created_at" FROM "orders_order" WHERE "orders_order"."user_id" = 1 ORDER BY "orders_order"."id" ASC

SELECT "orders_order"."id", "orders_order"."user_id", "orders_order"."created_at", (CAST(COALESCE((CAST(SUM((CAST((CAST(("orders_orderitem"."quantity" * "orders_orderitem"."unit_price") AS NUMERIC)) AS NUMERIC))) AS NUMERIC)), (CAST(0.00 AS NUMERIC))) AS NUMERIC)) AS "total" FROM "orders_order" LEFT OUTER JOIN "orders_orderitem" ON ("orders_order"."id" = "orders_orderitem"."order_id") WHERE "orders_order"."user_id" = 1 GROUP BY "orders_order"."id", "orders_order"."user_id", "orders_order"."created_at" ORDER BY "orders_order"."id" ASC
